about: Spec 014: the real complaint corpus (OEQ-12-26). Every /fix line of the 20261008 persona re-runs (talker 145410, fighter 145430) and three short forms of the round-3 complaints (ROUND3-ANALYSIS S3). `save` is a slimmed copy of the run's save (model calls and snapshots dropped, gzipped); `turn` is the report's own turn: the save is cut back to just before it (evals/feedback_corpus.py open_at). `note` is the player's note on what the report was about. `expected`: the categories and passage turns a right understanding may give, and the dispute record outcomes a right answer may end in (PR-12-11's table).

items.report: Ysrion says the guild is hiring extra hands for the autumn harvest, but the story began on the spring quarter day. Also the offer was meant to be a powerful person's work, money and a warning, and the warning he gave ("about no one you know") says nothing.
items.note: The season contradicts itself: it's spring but he talks about the autumn harvest. Ysrion also repeats the day-wages line three times and never gives the warning.

expected.why: the calendar says spring (day 1 of the first season); the narration slipped (store agrees)

items.report: Nibwen was carrying a basket to market, but now he's described as beating a rug, which is Ysrion's chore. Also Ysrion's reply about a wasting sickness in the Long Wolds has nothing to do with what I asked, and he had already turned his back and shut me out.
items.note: Nibwen's activity changed from carrying a basket to beating a rug. Ysrion cut in with an unrelated line about a sickness after he had refused to talk to me.

expected.why: incidental fiction: fact.95 'carrying a basket to market' (turn 1) was re-rolled to 'beating a rug' at turn 7; the player's continuity wins (pinned)

items.report: Nibwen already has the ale I bought him at the bar, but now he demands "another cup" before he'll go on. Earlier he also said "Not me in this, Garwen's yours to ask," and now he's butting in again. Also, Garwen answered the Seven Springs question, but the narration keeps repeating that Laendil learned the trade from Tibgit Lucky, which I never asked about.
items.note: Nibwen asking for a second drink right after I bought him one felt contradictory. The Tibgit Lucky line keeps repeating.

expected.why: incidental fiction with nothing on record: the player's reading wins (Nibwen has his ale)

items.report: The odds still count "beating a rug +2" as a bonus, but the text says Murzak has stopped beating the rug and turned to face me. So the bonus looks stale, and the target should be alert, not busy.
items.note: The odds screen contradicts the narration. It gives a bonus for Murzak being busy with the rug, but he has stopped and is looking at me.

expected.why: the open OFFER cites fact.92 'beating a rug' (generation, turn 1) as a lever; turn 2's narration says she left off: mechanics with uncertain evidence, explained and logged (INV-9)

items.report: My roll was a success (18 vs 10), but I didn't get the purse. The text says I have Murzak restrained and she hit me for 5 Vitality, though I never tried to grab her. A success should have lifted the purse.
items.note: The outcome contradicts the roll. I succeeded but got hurt and didn't get the purse. "Restrained" came from nowhere.

expected.why: frame.1 recomputes the same; it was framed as a grapple (verb.grapple), so its success wrote a hold, and nothing moved the purse (no typed change yet, spec 015): explain

items.report: That correction doesn't answer me. I never said my vitality was 18. My complaint is that I rolled a success (18 vs 10) and still didn't get the purse. Instead Murzak ended up restrained and hit me, though I never tried to grab her. Please give me the purse or explain why the success didn't lift it.
items.note: The last reply to my /fix was garbled. It said "Earlier I said your vitality was 18", which I never said, and it ignored the purse problem.

items.report: The offer calls Murzak "his" weight ("I lose my footing against his weight"), but Murzak Red-Hand has been "her" the whole scene. Also, I said I'd grab the purse and punch her again, but the offer only covers the grab.
items.note: The pronoun for Murzak flipped to "his" in the failure text. The offer also dropped the second half of my action, the punch.

expected.why: Murzak's pronouns on record are she/her: the store agrees, the narration slipped

items.report: I was Staggered with wound load 0/3 ("at wound load 3 you go Down"), but a single hit put me Down. Also the narration never says whether I still have Murzak's purse, which I grabbed with a critical success.
items.note: The knockout came after only one hit at load 0/3, which contradicts the status line. The purse's fate is also missing from the aftermath text.

expected.why: a harm ruling: explained from the record (what turn 15 wrote), logged for review
